name: Diabolical grants the caster a Crypt Swarm buff that Crypt Swarm damage consumes (#4167)
contract: Diabolical 704723 (CharacterAdvancement 4235, Animation tab, RequiredLevel 40) reads "Casting spells now grants you 1 stack of Diabolical, stacking up to $706504u times, for $706504d. Damage dealt by your Crypt Swarm will consume a stack to deal $707133s1% increased damage per stack." Its DBC trigger is 707133 (Rank 'Buff', TargetA caster, StackAmount 15, ToolTip 'Increases the damage of each tick of Crypt Swarm per remaining stack', effect 0 BasePoints 9 + 1 = 10), a beneficial aura. 706504 (Rank 'Stacks', TargetA enemy, ToolTip 'The Animation Necromancer's Crypt Fiend will deal additional Shadow Damage on hit to this target') is a harmful marker of an older enemy-debuff design. AscensionNecromancerAbilities.cpp casts the buff on the caster for every non-triggered spell, the damage-taken hook multiplies Crypt Swarm damage 800343 by 1 + 0.1 per stack, and each Crypt Swarm damage event removes one stack. Expected: casting spells with the talent gives the Necromancer the beneficial Diabolical buff 707133, not 706504; three casts give three stacks and Crypt Swarm is taken at 1300; channelling Crypt Swarm adds one stack and its ticks consume stacks. The stated 20 sec duration ($706504d) differs from the buff's native 30 sec and is not asserted. The damage-taken hook is probed on an opposing PvP-flagged player; spells and Crypt Swarm are cast on the golem.
